integrity: The proof is self-contained and supported by a standalone exact-integer checker; finite computation does not establish infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns canonical 0--1 incidence polytopes of K_{p,q} only when 2<=p<q. Weighted metrics, equal shores and noncomplete graphs are not covered; historical priority remains provisional.
title: A sharp diametral-pair transition in rectangular total-matching polytopes
